After you initiate a conﬁguration change, OpenSearch Service goes through a series of steps to
update your domain. You can view the progress of the conﬁguration change under Conﬁguration
change status in the console. The exact steps that an update goes through depends on
the type of change you're making. You can also monitor a conﬁguration change using the
DescribeDomainChangeProgress API operation.
The following are possible stages an update can go through during a conﬁguration change:
